operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: IDF Day 2 of Renewed Gaza Campaign; 4 Palestinians Killed as Kfir Brigade Eliminates Hamas Nukhba Operatives
heroSubtitle: Israel's renewed military campaign entered its second day on May 12, 2026 (Day 944), with IDF Kfir Brigade ground troops in central Gaza spotting Hamas Nukhba (elite force) operatives and calling in an Israeli Air Force airstrike that killed them. Israeli forces killed four Palestinians and wounded 16 across Gaza in 24 hours — the 215th consecutive day of ceasefire violations. Named victims included Mohammad Annaba, killed by a shell near the Bani Suheila roundabout in Khan Younis, and Mohammad Khader Totah, shot in the Zeitoun neighborhood of Gaza City. Cumulative deaths since the October 2025 ceasefire: 856 killed, 2,463 wounded. Total Gaza death toll stands at approximately 72,740+ killed since October 7, 2023. The UN OCHA May 7 situation report warned that 68% of Gaza's population is burning waste for fuel, 470,000 cubic meters of waste has accumulated in southern Gaza, and the 2026 humanitarian appeal remains under 10% funded. Chatham House analysts noted the Iran war has drawn global attention away from Gaza, reducing international advocacy for Palestinian civilians.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, WAFA, IMEMC, JNS, Jerusalem Post, Chatham House, and UN DPPA. Gaza death toll: 72,740+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023 (IMEMC/WAFA, May 12, 2026). 856 killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire (2,463 wounded). IDF security cabinet authorized war resumption May 10, 2026. Day 1 (May 11): 188th Brigade and Yahalom unit destroyed four Hamas tunnel structures in southern Gaza; Kfir Brigade destroyed 2 tunnel routes in central Gaza. Day 2 (May 12): Kfir Brigade kills Nukhba operatives via IAF airstrike; 4 Palestinians killed including Mohammad Annaba (Khan Younis shell) and Mohammad Khader Totah (Zeitoun sniper). 14,222 bodies remain under rubble. Only 17 of 36 hospitals partially functional. 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, under 10% funded. Day 944 of war.
